name: Georgia
summary_text: No state facility ban, but Atlanta is a long-run concentration point for killings of trans people (≥15 fatal cases 1990–2014, 16 more 2015–2023; 4.8 per 100k trans women/yr), and Colgay Pride — the long-running Diversity Saturday organiser in Columbus — cancelled its 2026 programming for the rest of the year because it could not meet heightened security requirements. Slightly below the national score 0.36.

sources.title: Safe States Don’t Make People Safer
sources.claim_summary: The Needle (July 2026) state-by-state analysis overlaying legislative-risk maps on recorded trans-homicide data: legal risk predicts how the state treats you, not how people do; this state's recorded killing rate for trans women is 4.8 per 100k/yr — all counts acknowledged floors from an undercounted monitoring project.

Columbus Ledger-Enquirer report: Colgay Pride cancelled its Diversity Saturday programming for the rest of 2026 'because of difficulty in providing heightened security requirements', per a letter from founder Jeremy Hobbs; the monthly LGBTQ community events had run in Columbus for about 11 years.
